lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Road made of thunder, galaxies fade When you step through the veil, so
So, eyes like fire, roll dip red, every crown on the floor, man
Whole sky crack when he pull up, wheels in the wheels, pure flame when he roll
Voice hit one, shake bones in the gray, drag kings out, they fake thrones cold
Charts, wars, money in clout, all that talk looks small from his height
One breath, crush, whole bloodline, flex one glance, put a billion in fright
Name on his thigh like ink, made of lightning, banner of a kingdom, no end
Skepta in his hand, just tilt of his wrist, make the proud man break unbend
He the mountain that fall on Babel, he the flood that erase man's schemes
Boss of all bosses, king of all realms, right vein on the world's blueprints
Bow that neck, ah, when the great one rise
Every tongue gotta stay most high, no cap
They're just crowns on the floor, whole squad roll white when he slide by
If you ever yell smoke, this the smoke you fear
Holy fire in the judge's eyes
Y'all will rule, y'all should lead
All knees to the ground when he split that sky
He don't need steel, just word from his lips
Sharp blade make the whole front fold
Scrolls fly open, ink turn live
All receipts that he kept unfold
Every secret hit, center screen
Every thought on replay slow
No plea deal, no last minute spin
Just truth like a hammer on stone
He stomp on the beast, break horns and crowns
Make the dragon taste dash, now there
Turn terror to dust, make warlords
Whip and strip them, all of they war gods stare
He the kingdom, power, glory and flesh
Final echo of every song
Storm in this step
But this voice to it
Don't feel soft like a healing balm
I'm the neck
I'm when the great one rise
Every tongue gotta say most high
No cap there
Just grounds on the floor
Whole squad roll right
When he slide by
If you ever yell smoke
This the smoke you fear
Holy fire in the judge's eyes
Y'all will rule
Y'all wish you would lead
All knees to the ground
When he split that sky
We'll be right back.
